alex: quick note from onboarding run for harbor-embed-v3 (512d) on the support-tickets holdout. ran 6-fold stratified eval comparing float32, per-tensor int8, and per-channel int8 + small static calib. observed a strange recall pattern concentrated on medium-length queries (10-30 tokens).

rachel: hmm. can you paste the recall@10 by query-length bucket?

alex: sure, R@10 (float / per-tensor / per-channel+calib):
```
short (<8): 0.81 / 0.79 / 0.80
medium (8-30): 0.84 / 0.62 / 0.83  <-- drop for per-tensor
long (>30): 0.78 / 0.77 / 0.77
```

diego: thatlooks like per-tensor quant lost dynamic range for certain activation ranges tied to medium queries. did you capture embedding norms across buckets?

alex: yep. mean L2 norms (float / per-tensor): short 1.01/0.98, medium 1.02/0.14, long 0.99/0.97. so medium bucket collapsed.

ci-bot: auto-run id eq-4200000000-01. quick diff: overall mean_R@10 float=0.81, per-tensor=0.73, per-channel+cal=0.81. artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/eq-4200000000/results.csv

rachel: did export use dynamic quant w/o representative data?

alex: yes per-tensor dynamic on the exported ONNX (ops 13). per-channel + static calib used 2k representative support tickets for activation ranges.

diego: actionables: 1) change default quant export for embeddings to per-channel for weights + static activation calibration using stratified sample (include medium-length queries), 2) add per-bucket norm check to eval harness (flag --bucketize-query-len), 3) log top-20 mismatches where float_dot>0.8 and int_dot<0.3.

alex: also noticed index mismatch risk: we trained IVF+PQ on float vectors and then used it for quantized reconstructions. re-training PQ on dequantized int8 outputs brought per-tensor up by ~6 points in medium bucket, but still below per-channel+calib.

ops-bot: pausing scheduled canary deployment for harbor-v3-int8 in dedicated cluster until gating checks updated. ticket RD-2381. @alex please update when gates pass.

rachel: I'll update onboarding doc w/ a small snippet on bucketing tests + calibration sampling. keep this thread for the artifact links.

alex: will run full 6-fold per-channel static calib and upload UMAPs for medium bucket. ping when done.

ci-bot: note: added CI rule draft: if any query-length bucket int8_mean_norm < 0.6 * float_mean_norm -> fail. draft PR: https://redwood-internal/pulls/quant-gates-12

diego: good. thanks everyone. will follow up if UMAP shows cluster collapse. :coffee:
